definitions.explanation: a formal notification submitted when unable to attend school, work, or a meeting

examples.japanese: {欠席届|けっせきとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
⟦{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}→体調不良：20233_taichoufuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{欠席届|けっせきとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I submitted an absence notice due to feeling unwell.

examples.english: Please submit your absence notice in advance.

notes:
{欠席届|けっせきとどけ} is a formal document submitted to notify school or work of an absence.

COMMON VERBS:
- {欠席届|けっせきとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to submit an absence notice
- {欠席届|けっせきとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit (formal)
- {欠席届|けっせきとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write an absence notice

USAGE:
Used in schools, universities, and workplaces. Often requires stating the reason (⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧) and expected duration. May need to be submitted in advance (⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) or as soon as possible after the absence begins.
